items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: then Willard William Alexander came into William Morris and he said, well you're going to have to cut the band down.

ctx.x: And I knew it was going to go, then Willard William Alexander came into William Morris and he said, well you're going to have to cut the band down. Well they'd taken care of all these arrangements and we had a whole book -- so I said, 'I can't do that, it's disappointing, can't we make a go of it.' He said -- 'Well, let me think a minute.' But he finally said, 'No, it's impossible. In this day and age to go -- you got too many men, you have to cut down, to a smaller.'
Get the nut smaller, you mean.
